pipelines.label: Sci-Fi News Pro Multipass (LLM-first whole-play markup)

passes.description: P0: python-capped source digest -> DossierArtifact (facts, allowed numbers, entities, dramatizable vectors).
P1 creative: dossier + one dealt frame card + stance -> one pitch object. This is the pitch authority.
P2 creative: dossier + sole pitch + stance + N_MAX -> Treatment (cast shapes, priced ending, news thread). Cast names are born here.
P2 technical: dossier + provenance -> the factual close under source-grounding laws; stamped onto treatment.news_close_read.
P3 creative: treatment + digest -> the complete play in strict markup. Only malformed or truncated markup opens a bounded retry; the first clean parse wins.
Bounded exact-line cleanup of the same P3 artifact for the narrow terminal prose safety policy; IDs, speakers, ordering, source facts, and topology stay fixed.
Seals normalized P3 text, parse proof, constituent hashes, and source-grounded factual-read evidence after cleanup.
Technical casting: the accepted parsed script + cast shapes + dealt voice menu -> CastingVoices. Story text is not rewritten.
Pure Python assembly of the sealed FinalDraft + Treatment into proof-backed ledger rows, followed by non-strict actual-word telemetry and authorship/delivery seals.

notes: Visible experiment; failure NEVER routes to legacy_many_pass.
Consumes the bank fetcher payload via the writer's shared fetch lane; interpreter intentionally empty -- the treatment IS the interpretation.
executable:true = nodes/_otr_scifi_fable2.py via the writer's _RUNNER_BY_PIPELINE dispatch. Every requested duration runs the same fixed one-pitch, one-P3-artifact topology.
Python judges; the LLM writes: every spoken ledger row must be traceable to a named LLM artifact (proof gate).

pipelines.label: Sci-Fi News Circuit

passes.description: Consumes A0, extracts source-spanned facts, entities, numbers, and tone, and fails if evidence cannot be indexed.
Turns P0 constraints into a fiction-marked dramatic question without treating invention as reporting.
Builds the fixed-size cast and audible conflict graph from P1.
Builds scenes, shots, beats, music cues, fact placements, and advisory beat-length centers.
Writes the sole compact closed {line_id,text} spoken artifact. The creative structured ladder repairs only malformed schema or closed graph/roster IDs.
Bounded exact-line cleanup of the same P5 artifact for the narrow terminal prose safety policy; graph, IDs, speakers, ordering, facts, and topology stay fixed.
Validates graph/roster/order and assembles the canonical ledger once, then stamps non-strict actual-word telemetry and authorship.
Runs the existing tail finalizer, freeze, save/reopen audit, media, and publish sequence without length- or quality-based liveness gates.

notes: A0 is the first artifact and P0 is the first model call.
P3 has one structural artifact ladder; the optional text patch touches nonspoken transport fields only.
P5 is the sole spoken-story authority. Only malformed schema, closed graph/roster IDs, or the narrow terminal safety policy may open bounded same-artifact repair.
Assembly and tail finalization are deterministic orchestration stages; word count and quality are telemetry only.
